wth.text: Starke serves Volrath while pretending to help the Weatherlight's crew, and he bargains to deliver Sisay in exchange for his daughter Takara's life.
He lures Crovax away from the Weatherlight by telling him that Selenia is imprisoned on Rath, and then he betrays Sisay by orchestrating her capture through a planar portal.
When Maraxus catches him and burns Alaric's estate, Starke stabs Maraxus in the back before he can reveal the betrayal to Gerrard, and he lies to Gerrard that he had to kill and pledges his loyalty.

He then switches sides and guides the crew through the Stronghold, but he is blinded by a mind-controlled Takara, and on Mercadia the false Takara is revealed to be a shapeshifted Volrath, who murders him in retribution.

plc.text: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that Volrath is the sidar's son, and he names his price for the information: his daughter.

When Maraxus corners him for betraying Volrath's secrets, Starke offers to bring him the woman who knows where Gerrard is, and then he opens a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag Sisay away.
Starke gained nothing by the betrayal, and he begs Crovax to hide him, and Crovax sends him to his friend Alaric, but Maraxus's forces drag Starke out of the wine cellar and tear down the mansion.

Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax rescue him, and when Maraxus attacks the sleeping group Starke stabs him in the back of the neck, then offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom, and Gerrard says he has no reason to trust him but will watch him constantly.
